review_mode: Read source/protocol only; no fitting,IK,Fk,native integration or fresh output consumption
required_before_execution_or_freeze: Bind completed geometry receipt to root/geometry protocol and exact fitted model; require complete healthy23/prepared21 coordinate maps and marker-preservation whitelist.
Freeze preparation/dynamic protocols before their solvers/native runs; retain any nonidentity or infrastructure failure in new exclusive artifacts.
Freeze numerical/phase consumers before reading any fresh output; source hash-union must include new adapters and full runtime manifest.
interpretation_limits: Y-only knee target does not prove equality of 3D centers or functional/mechanical axes.
Fixed device foot support determines device ankle height; own healthy ankle height is diagnostic and independently imposing it could overconstrain assembly.
Mesh heel+forefoot support is an encoded geometric benchmark; physical floor, contact patch and clinical alignment are not independently identified.
Quiet-standing representative is acquired nonzero posture, not synthetic zero/knee lock; static angle mapping is a marker/IK reference convention.
Forward comparison evaluates coherent new geometry+marker calibration+fullIK preparation, not geometry-only causation.
Compare signed and absolute reserve impulse/work,RMS and all biological coordinates; low signed pelvis support alone does not establish physiological success.
20N measured nominal phase,binary events and retained actor FSM cycles remain separate; late closingHS matching guard censored.
